junro.title: Prioritree MCP — the agent-callable surface: the core's five-op interface exposed as OunceMCP tools — the banked tooling decision realized (the tier's own effort: composition, gates, the exposure's shape), the core staying zero-dep; the surface USABLE BY THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS, not only external agents; the full junro, all seats participating
inputs: Q-mcp-surface's banked ruling at the prioritree-core store (2026-11-20): the MCP surface uses OunceMCP (subbusainath.github.io/ouncemcp/ — a Python framework on FastMCP: token-budgeted tool definitions and results, idempotent writes replayed never repeated, approvals before changes, verified-token identity, caller-bound handles, large-catalog discovery, proof tooling); the five ops land as its tools; the core stays zero-dep; OunceMCP rides the MCP tier's wrapper, exactly as the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, and the web fronts

THE COLLABORATOR'S CONVENING RULING (2026-11-22): the MCP surface must be usable BY THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS — the agent-facing analogue of the member-callable law (prioritree-ux R12/R13): the appropriate seats call/interact with the MCP tools directly from their own seats (a member-facing client path, a tool grant, or the MCP server's own callable surface — the design rules the form)

the service era's whole record (the prioritree-ux effort, done 2026-11-22): the six JSON routes (the five ops + the manifest query) live and ThreePart 21/21; the web tier live (the comparator's flow whole); the lifecycle targets + the member-callable lifecycle tool (the grant map's own precedent — the form this effort extends to the MCP tier)

the standing laws carried from prioritree-ux (R1-R13): the full-junro all-seats mandate; the seat-authored report (R6/R11 — the record never rides the return channel); the per-step dispatch (R8 — one step, one dispatch, one bounded return); the ThreePart error shape mandatory (R5); the member-callable surface + the readable runtime (R12/R13)
CONTINUATION.md's WHERE section (the named next era: the MCP-surface effort composing at the collaborator's hand)

structure.purpose: THE PER-UNIT PIPELINE (the standing form): THE CENSUS FIRST — ungated tansa/shindan/rikai packets over the MCP-era ground (OunceMCP's own surface, the exposure shape today, the member-path design space); then THE DESIGN LANE — ungated suisen/keisan/hyoka/moho packets; then togo's gated synthesis closing G-MCP-DESIGN-BRIEF; each build unit's ungated discovery legs + gated brief precede its build; THE ROUTE GROWS UNIT-BY-UNIT (the build-add auto-stamps the pair; the spec lane rides the unique suffix — the two-lane standing shape).
structure.entry_condition: G-COMPOSITION is green (the composition validated at the route's head); the census fires first, its findings assumed by none of this composition.

structure.purpose: THE MCP TIER'S BUILD — the units the census and design earn (the likely set, named not pinned: mcp-server — the OunceMCP wrapper over the five ops; member-path — the members' callable surface; lifecycle integration — the MCP server's own start/stop riding the standing form), one module per dispatch (R8's per-step law at build time), each landing per its approved brief (the exact-task law), kensho's independent verification per build gate, one-commit-per-increment; the ThreePart mandatory at the tools' refusals; the core zero-dep held.
structure.entry_condition: G-MCP-DESIGN-BRIEF is green — the design is the spec; each unit's own G-<UNIT>-BRIEF green before its dispatch (the precedence law).

structure.purpose: THE EFFORT'S BOOKEND (the standing form): hansei's retro (the friction ledger the intake), the effort's records (the CONTINUATION entry; the next era named — the widening paths banked or the collaborator's next call), the done call at the collaborator's ruling.
structure.entry_condition: the route's build gates closed green and the collaborator has called the close.

conditions: the composition lands at the store's reports home (reports/compose/route.md — keikaku's own report, the composition whole: stages, gates, increments, the ungated placements, the application order) — the opening whole, the census placed FIRST with none of its findings assumed, every seat placed (R4: no seat bypassed)

every choice cites its ruling: Q-mcp-tools' three (the banked OunceMCP decision, the member-usable law, the governance form) + the standing laws carried from prioritree-ux (R1-R13 as the inputs name them)
the collaborator validates the composition — the gate is the validation; the outcome records against compose/route; no route dispatch fires before it is green

THE DESIGN BRIEF LANDED: togo's synthesis over the census (census/ouncemcp, census/exposure, census/member-path) + the design lane (design/tools, design/member-path, design/budgets, design/adversarial, design/blind-walk); a divergence that survives reconciliation blocks the brief, never rides silently

the brief carries the design-work whole the rulings leave open: the five tools' definitions + budgets (the banked decision's discipline), the member-usable path's form + the minimum-grant map + the same stamps comparator_id/class (the member-usable law), the ThreePart seam (R5 carried — the tools' refusals carry expected/found/next-action), the discipline mapping (idempotency=R9's dedup, budgets=narrow-interface, approvals/handles=write-path strictness)
THE COLLABORATOR'S APPROVAL: the design judged ready-to-build; the build units' briefs cite it; their dispatches fire only after their own brief gates green
hansei's retro landed: the debrief over the effort whole, the friction ledger the intake, the lessons named

the effort's records landed: the CONTINUATION entry (the landing state named honestly); the next era named (the MCP surface's successors — the widening paths banked: multi-process, auth, the both-directions probe — or the collaborator's next call)
the collaborator rules the close — the done call recorded same-turn; the route's status set done at the ruling

open_questions.question: What is prioritree's MCP surface — the core's five-op interface (register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank) exposed as OunceMCP tools (the banked ruling realized), the tier's own shape (composition, gates, the exposure's budgeting/approval/handle discipline), the core staying zero-dep — AND the surface usable by the appropriate team members directly from their own seats (the member-callable law's agent-facing analogue)?

rulings.text: THE BANKED DECISION CARRIED (Q-mcp-surface's ruling at the prioritree-core store, 2026-11-20, realized by this effort): the MCP surface uses OunceMCP (subbusainath.github.io/ouncemcp/ — a Python framework built on FastMCP: small tool definitions, results that fit the context window, token-budgeted tools and results, idempotent writes replayed never repeated, approvals before changes, verified-token identity, caller-bound handles, large-catalog discovery, proof tooling). THE FIVE OPS LAND AS ITS TOOLS: register_run, next_pair, cast_vote, read_vote_state, tally_rank — the same interface the CLI wraps, FastAPI serves, and the web fronts. THE CORE STAYS ZERO-DEP (the ruled data plane); OunceMCP rides the MCP tier's wrapper. THE RESONANCE (recorded at the bank): the framework's built-ins implement the product's own ruled disciplines — idempotent writes replayed-never-repeated is R9's loud idempotent dedup; token-budgeted small tool definitions is the narrow-interface doctrine; approvals-before-changes and caller-bound handles harden the write path where the design spends its strictness.

THE MEMBER-USABLE MCP LAW (collaborator ruling, 2026-11-22, verbatim ground: "we need to also be able to use the MCP from the appropriate team members."): the MCP surface is NOT only an external-agent-facing tier — THE APPROPRIATE TEAM MEMBERS use it directly from their own seats: the agent-facing analogue of the member-callable law (prioritree-ux R12/R13, whose lifecycle tool is the standing precedent). THE REQUIREMENT: a member-facing path to the MCP tools (the design rules the form — a member-callable MCP client path, a tool grant wrapping the client, the MCP server's own callable surface exposed to the seats, or another form the design settles); the appropriate seats' map (which members get which tools — the minimum-grant principle, the lifecycle grant map's own form); the members' calls carrying the same stamps the external agents carry (comparator_id, class — the vote's provenance whole). THE STANDING PRECEDENT CARRIED: the lifecycle tool's grant map (full at the working seats, read at the analysis seats, deny elsewhere) is the form this effort extends; the FR-MEM-0014 drift lesson rides (the grant lands at the tree, the delivery at the launch — the restart note).

THE GOVERNANCE FORM CARRIED (the full junro, all seats — the ux effort's standing law R4, held at this effort from birth): every seat rides the route — keikaku composes; tansa, shindan, and rikai discover and diagnose (the MCP-era ground: OunceMCP's own surface, the banked decision's fit, the FastMCP substrate); suisen and keisan recommend and calculate (the exposure's shape, the tool definitions' budgets); hyoka assesses adversarially; moho blind-walks; togo synthesizes; jikko executes per-step; kensho verifies independently; hansei debriefs; shinko dispatches. THE STANDING LAWS RIDE WHOLE: the seat-authored report (R6/R11 — the record never rides the return channel); the per-step dispatch (R8 — one step, one dispatch, one bounded return; the spec's sequence IS the dispatch plan); the TwoPart brief→spec→build form (the two-lane standing shape); the ThreePart error shape mandatory (R5 — the MCP tools' refusals carry expected/found/next-action as the wire's family grammar does); the transit-envelope discipline (the set-form evidence, the sized dispatches).
